            <div class="eventlist-description"><div class="sqs-layout sqs-grid-12 columns-12" data-layout-label="Post Body" data-type="item" data-updated-on="1782914042799" id="item-6a451bc377aab9281573dc20"><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-12 span-12"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-4f31f6128814370f58b9"><div class="sqs-block-content">

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h1 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Family Connections Ministry</h1>
</div>




















  
  



</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1783006904002_20952"><div class="sqs-block-content">

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">St. Catherine Parish is excited to introduce our new <strong>Family Connections Ministry</strong>, a monthly gathering designed to strengthen relationships among families in our parish while creating opportunities for meaningful spiritual conversations.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">In today's busy world, families often long for deeper connections, with one another, with their faith community, and with God. Our Family Connections events will provide a welcoming environment where families can come together for fellowship, fun activities, shared meals, and faith-filled discussions.</p><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Our Mission</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">To build a stronger parish family by fostering authentic relationships among families and encouraging conversations that help us grow in faith together.</p><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">What to Expect Each Month</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">·&nbsp;Family-friendly activities and games</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">·&nbsp;Opportunities to meet and connect with other families</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">·&nbsp;Guided faith discussions relevant to everyday family life</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">·&nbsp;Prayer and spiritual reflection</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">&nbsp;</p><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">A welcoming atmosphere for families of all ages and backgrounds</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">&nbsp;</p>
</div>




















  
  



</div></div></div></div></div></div>
            
          

          <a href="/new-events/2026/7/11/bll1oo8e66s76klrljb3bo2mk9mje0" class="eventlist-button sqs-editable-button sqs-button-element--primary">
            View Event &#8594;
          </a>
